title: Banjo player Caffrey and Johnny St. Cyr
summary: He praises Caffrey as one of the best banjo players, who was killed in Texas, and talks of Johnny St. Cyr writing from California.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What kind of banjo player you thought Caffrey was? Who? Caffrey. What kind of banjo player he was?
What did I think about Caffrey?
Oh, he was a good banjo player. Yeah, Caffrey's a good... Caffrey's a good... Caffrey's one of the best banjo players he had down there.
I never got to know him.
Huh? I never heard him or knew him.
No, he got killed. He got killed in Texas.
Oh, he had a gambling place or something in Texas. I think I heard about it.
Well, I don't know what he did after you left here. He's got some people live... Sister... One day... I'll contact one day. His sister... His sister lives around there.
His sister lives right there on there. That in Galveston.

Johnny St. Cyr gave me a picture of that... Johnny St. Cyr? I think he played there a little bit. Did he ever work with you? He what? Did Johnny ever play with you? What happened to him? Did he play or work in that same band? In the same band? With you? At the New Garden?

Oh, since the way he'd been away. Yeah, yeah. He used to play together all the time. And then... A long time ago? Oh, yeah. He used to write to me all the time, writing out from California. Yeah, my son used to stay... He used to run by his house. Mm-hmm.
